title_en: Tuition Payment and Course Registration for Students Expected to Complete Coursework
summary: Graduate students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering who are registering for a regular semester to meet the coursework completion (수료) requirements must pay tuition; course registration is optional for them unless they have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters or are research students who have exceeded the prescribed semesters (초과자연구생), in which case course registration is also mandatory. All other enrolled students must both pay tuition and register for courses. The notice gives no deadlines; students who are unsure of their situation should contact the department office.
applies_to: Graduate students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. (1) Students expected to complete coursework who register only to meet the minimum enrollment period or tuition payment requirement for completion: tuition payment is mandatory, course registration is optional. (2) Students who have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters (master's and doctoral students from their 5th semester; integrated master's-doctoral program students from their 9th semester): tuition payment and course registration are both mandatory. (3) Research students who have exceeded the prescribed semesters (초과자연구생): course registration is mandatory. (4) All other enrolled students (general enrolled students, 일반 재학생): tuition payment and course registration are both mandatory.
conditions: Students registering only to meet the minimum enrollment period or tuition payment requirement for coursework completion must pay regular-semester tuition, but course registration is optional.

For example, a master's student who has met all other completion requirements but must register a 4th time (at least 4 registrations are required) does not need to register for courses in that 4th registration.

This exception does not apply to students who have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters: master's and doctoral students from their 5th semester and integrated master's-doctoral program students from their 9th semester must pay tuition and register for courses.
Students who have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters and neither register for courses (earn credits) nor take a leave of absence will be expelled (제적).
Research students who have exceeded the prescribed semesters (초과자연구생) must also register for courses.
General enrolled students who are not expected to complete coursework must pay tuition and register for courses.
These rules may differ in special cases or individual circumstances; students who cannot determine their situation should ask the department office.
steps: Determine which case applies to you (registration only to meet completion requirements, exceeded prescribed semesters, research student beyond prescribed semesters, or general enrolled student); if unsure, contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
Research students beyond prescribed semesters: read the reference notice at https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57896.
Pay the regular-semester tuition (required in all cases).

Register for courses if you have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters, are a research student beyond the prescribed semesters, or are a general enrolled student; if you have exceeded the prescribed semesters and will not register for courses, take a leave of absence instead to avoid expulsion.
translation:
Title: Notice on Tuition Payment and Course Registration for Students Expected to Complete Coursework

1. Registration to meet the minimum enrollment period / tuition payment requirement for coursework completion (수료)
- In this case, payment of regular-semester tuition is mandatory, but course registration (수강신청) is optional.
- For example, if you have met all requirements for master's coursework completion but must register for a 4th time because at least 4 registrations are required, you do not need to register for courses when you register for the 4th time.

2. However, students who have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters (규정학기초과자) must register for courses.
- Students who have exceeded the prescribed number of semesters: master's and doctoral students from their 5th semester; integrated master's-doctoral program (석박통합과정) students from their 9th semester.
- For example, if you are in your 5th semester of the master's program, you must both register (pay tuition) and register for courses.
※ If you do not register for courses (earn credits) or take a leave of absence, you will be expelled (제적).

3. Research students who have exceeded the prescribed semesters (초과자연구생) must also register for courses.
- Reference link: https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57896

4. [General enrolled students] (일반 재학생) who are not in the situations above (such as students expected to complete coursework) must register (pay tuition) and register for courses.

The above may vary in special cases or depending on individual student circumstances, so if it is difficult to determine your exact situation, please contact the department office once more.

● Contact: Administrative Office, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (contact details are given in the original notice).
